other.name: The Brothers' War Bundle Land Pack

sealed.name: The Brothers' War Set Booster Pack

extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The Brothers’ War Bundle contains 8 The Brothers’ War Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 Traditional Foil promo card with Bundle-exclusive alternate art, 1 oversized Spindown life counter (red or green), 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards.
Each The Brothers’ War Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token/ad card or card from “The List” (a special card from Magic's history—found in 25% of packs), with a combination of 1–5 card(s) of rarity Rare or higher and 3–7 Uncommon, 3–6 Common, and 1 Land cards. Traditional Foil Land replaces basic land in 20% of Set Boosters. Foil-Stamped Signature Art Card replaces Art Card in 10% of Set Boosters.

Contents:
• 8 The Brothers’ War Set Boosters
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter (red or green) + card storage box
• Travel back in time to command powerful artifacts and giant robots
